about: Fixed questions for comparing the ontology researcher with a plain web session. 'covered' questions have saved findings in the maintainer's local knowledge base; 'uncovered' ones do not.

questions.question: In Klimczuk et al. (2024) on 3D-printed PLA, how much mass did the PLA1 specimens lose after 35 days at pH 10, and what does that gravimetric result not establish?
What glass transition temperatures do open-access DSC studies report for neat poly(butylene succinate), and at what heating rate and scan?
What DSC melting temperature and crystallinity are reported for neat polycaprolactone (for example Capa 6800), with heating rate and scan?
In Lawler et al. (2012) on end-of-life reverse-osmosis membranes, what sodium hypochlorite concentration and exposure time were used to treat BW30FR membranes?
What tensile modulus and elongation at break are reported for neat polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB) films in open-access studies, with test standard and specimen conditions?
What oxygen permeability is reported for neat PLA film in open-access studies, with film thickness, temperature and relative humidity?
What glass transition temperature is reported for neat poly(methyl methacrylate) by DSC in open-access studies, with heating rate and scan?
What heat deflection temperature is reported for neat polycarbonate, with the load, standard and specimen conditioning?
